english.title: Allow a vehicle / animal / thing to be on Stansted Airport London when forbidden
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) allowed

(A)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY THE VEHICLE..),]_
(B)_[an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..),]_
(C)_[a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..),]_

to be on Stansted Airport London after its presence on the airport had been forbidden by a constable or an airport official who had reasonable grounds to believe that its presence has been responsible for or was about to be responsible for a breach of a byelaw or for a criminal offence
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3(10) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
